additionalProperties.description:
Key must be the name of a file (including extension) under `./audio/`.

Filename schema can be found in `./filename-schema.md`.

url.description:
The article URL of the performance.

Preferably YouTube (youtu.be).

artist.description:
Object detailing info about the artist behind this performance of the song.

If this is not the artist of the original performance, see documentation on the "type" and "original" keys.

name.description:
The alias of the artist.

If it cannot be specified, simply write the reason, e.g. "Unknown" (note the capital casing).

url.description:
An associable platform of the artist.

Should match the platform of the provided song URL.

type.description:
If the performance is an original, or by the original artist, "type" should be unspecified. (If the performance is by the original artist, but not the *original* performance, that should be detailed in the song title.)

If the performance is a reperformance not by the original artist, "type" should be a string documenting the type of re-performance with few keywords, e.g. "cover" or "remix" (note the lowercase casing).

comments.description:
Personal comments on the song, parsed as Markdown.

This is parsed with soft line breaks, so it is recommended to use the pipe symbol ("|") for block notation so that newlines in the source text are preserved.

original.description:
Object detailing info about the original performance of the song.

Required if the "type" key is set.

url.description: The article URL of the original song.

artist.description: Object detailing info about the artist of the original song.

name.description:
The alias of the original artist.

If it cannot be specified, simply write the reason, e.g. "Unknown" (note the capital casing).

url.description:
An associable platform of the artist.

Should match the platform of the provided song URL.
